messages:
Diego R.: Hey finance team — received invoice CFDI-2026-09 from CDMX Cloud Services for platform usage (MXN 146,300). Vendor marked themselves as 'nonresident' on the PDF and didn't include an RFC for tax withholding. They also attached a nota fiscal that looks odd. Should we apply Mexico withholding or ask for RFC / CFDI 4.0 XML?

Marcela V.: Can you paste the lines they filled? For Mexican suppliers we need RFC and a valid CFDI XML to validate the 'comprobante' and tax regimes. If they claim nonresident status we need a RFC or a foreigner tax ID plus evidence.

Diego R.: Here's the text from the invoice: 
"Proveedor: CDMX Cloud Services
RFC: - (nonresident)
Concepto: Servicios de software
Total: MXN 146,300

Attached: invoice.pdf (no CFDI XML), note: 'Supplier is foreign entity, tax withheld at source should be applied by payer'"

Anita P.: If vendor is a foreign entity providing services in Mexico, withholding rules can apply (ISR and IVA treatment depends on place of supply). But vendor cannot simply ask us to withhold without documentation. We need either: (A) a validated CFDI issued in Mexico with their RFC, or (B) if truly foreign, a declaration and their fiscal ID plus statement of where services were performed. Also check if they meant "no RFC" because they are a foreign branch of a Mexican entity.

Leo H.: Operationally: hold payment until we get the CFDI XML or a formal tax residency declaration. If vendor insists on withholding and we apply it incorrectly, we could misreport. AP-bot, flag invoice and set hold.

AP-bot: Hold flag applied on invoice CFDI-2026-09 — reason: missing RFC/CFDI validation. AP queue notified.

Marcela V.: I'll reach out to our Mexico tax advisor to confirm the exact withholding rates if services were rendered in Mexico by a foreign supplier. Typical ISR withholding on foreign services is around 10% but depends on treaty. IVA (16%) may or may not apply. Do not gross-up.

Diego R.: Drafting vendor message, posting now: 
"Hi CDMX Cloud Services — thanks for the invoice. To process payment we need a valid CFDI XML (CFDI 4.0) including your RFC. If you are a foreign entity, please provide your tax ID, a declaration of tax residency, and confirmation of the country where the services were performed. Please clarify whether you expect Redwood to withhold taxes and provide supporting documentation. Payment will remain on hold until we receive the requested documentation. If you charge Mexican VAT (IVA), please reissue the invoice showing IVA line and RFC.

Best, Diego on behalf of Redwood AP"

Anita P.: Also ask them to confirm bank details and whether they want payment in MXN or USD. If they push for immediate payment, escalate to Legal.

Diego R.: Sent to vendor at 2026-09-14T14:08:42Z cc: vendor-ops.

AP-bot: Vendor message posted to payments@cdmx-cloud.example and hold expiry set to 2026-09-21T23:59:00Z unless docs received earlier.

Marcela V.: I'll follow up with tax advisor and update thread if rates or obligations differ. Closing for now — reopen once we have CFDI or vendor reply. :white_check_mark:
